programmes.programName: PhD research through Operations and Service Management
programmes.evidence: Current official school department inventory names OSM Department and explicitly states MPhil/PhD/DBA teaching. The department research-supervision page says it recruits and supervises PhD candidates, including Applied Operational Research and Operations. Degree title is generic PhD; the qualifying title is the reviewed host department.
limitations: The separate supervision page retains an older Operations and Information Management label; present organizational succession is unresolved.

branches.conclusion: Current Aston Business School department inventory states Operations and Service Management offers doctoral-level teaching; official departmental research page states PhD supervision. One department-hosted generic PhD pathway recorded, not a separately titled Operations degree.
Engineering-school doctoral and named-title inventory not yet fully checked, so other qualifying routes remain possible.
